release_status.value: README says code and part of dataset will be released soon; reviewed pinned tree contains README, project-site documents and images, not a verified runnable framework, checkpoint or full dataset release

evidence_boundaries: Human motion generation and understanding, not demonstrated robot whole-body task control
Web videos yield WHAM SMPL pseudo-labels refined with PHC; this is distinct from the VLMM generator
Five million motions differs from one hundred million multi-task instructional instances
Table 1 is benchmark-specific HumanML3D training; starred Figure 4 model additionally uses full HuMo100M
Higher semantic alignment does not imply best HumanML3D generation FID
I2M means Instruct-to-Motion despite Table 2 caption saying Image-to-Motion
Motion FPS under quantized inference is not robot closed-loop control frequency
HuMo263 component dimensions enumerated in v1 total 197, leaving actual feature layout unverified
